persona.name: Marcus Bell
persona.summary: Bootcamp graduate changing careers after seven years in warehouse operations
persona.background: Supervised warehouse shifts for nearly seven years, where he taught himself SQL to build reports. Completed a full-stack bootcamp in 2026 and now works part time as a bootcamp teaching assistant. Applying for junior frontend, full-stack, and support engineering roles.
goals: Show that his operations experience is relevant without overstating his engineering experience
Get past screens that want professional software experience
frustrations: Generic resume tools either hide his operations history or make it sound like engineering
Worries that '7 years of experience' will be read as software experience
evaluator_notes: His only professional software-adjacent work is SQL reporting and a part-time TA role
Operations history is genuinely relevant for support and logistics roles

bullets.bullet_text: Help 20 evening-cohort students debug JavaScript and React assignments during weekly office hours
Supervised a shift team of 14 warehouse associates across receiving and outbound
Wrote SQL queries against the warehouse management system to build weekly on-time-shipment and inventory-accuracy reports for site leadership
Resolved escalated delivery issues with carriers and customers, keeping on-time shipment above 97% for two years
Trained 30+ new associates on scanning devices and the warehouse management system

projects.description: Shift-trading web app for hourly workers

bullets.bullet_text: Built a React and TypeScript front end and an Express REST API for posting and claiming shifts
Designed a PostgreSQL schema with constraints that prevent double-booking
Wrote Jest tests for the API routes and deployed the app on Render
Built a Flask app that schedules truck arrivals into dock slots and flags conflicts
Based the scheduling rules on dock operations I managed as a supervisor

projects.description: Inventory tracker for a food bank (volunteer)

bullets.bullet_text: Built a Next.js inventory page that 6 volunteers use to log weekly donations
